header: The Gemini page reader. A vision model reads layout, Hindi, Bengali and symbols well but can invent a digit or stop early, so I have every page read by TWO models (a primary and a checker, geminiOcr.ts): where they agree, a value is very probably right; where they disagree, it is flagged (readingCheck.ts). This file is only the connection to Gemini, and I keep it behind one small interface. PAGE_READER=gemini (needs GEMINI_API_KEY; GEMINI_VISION_MODEL names the model, default below: model names are retired from time to time) PAGE_READER unset or "none": no second reader A reading that is cut off (Gemini's finishReason is not STOP) or in which the model began repeating itself ends with STOPPED_MARKER, so that it is never mistaken for a complete reading.

symbols.name: AttemptInfo
doc: One failed attempt of a read: which attempt, how long it ran and why it failed.

members.name: onAttempt
doc: Called after every attempt that failed and will be retried (or was the last): it feeds the log of an upload.

members.name: note
doc: Plain words on how the reader is set up (for the upload log), e.g. that page images are shrunk.

members.name: read
doc: Gives the text of one page image. Throws if the service fails.

symbols.name: FetchLike
symbols.sig: (url: string, init: { method: string; headers: Record<string, string>; body: string; signal?: AbortSignal }) => Promise<{ ok: boolean; status: number; text(): Promise<string>; json(): Promise<any>; }>

symbols.name: PAGE_READER_PROMPT
symbols.sig: const PAGE_READER_PROMPT = `You are transcribing ONE page of a scanned official document of a steel plant. The page is in English, Hindi, sometimes …

symbols.name: BACKOFF_MS
doc: I wait 1.5 s before the first retry and 4 s before the second.

symbols.name: QuotaInfo
doc: What a 429 ("You exceeded your current quota") says: which limit was hit and how long to wait.

members.name: kind
doc: per-day: today's allowance is used up, so no wait helps. per-minute: wait and retry. other: no detail given.

members.name: summary
doc: One plain line, without brackets, for logs and for the uploader.

members.name: retryAfterMs
doc: How long the service asked me to wait before the next request.

symbols.name: parseQuotaError
doc: Reads the body of a 429 (Google's error JSON: quotaId, quotaValue, retryDelay, or only the message "Please retry in 31.5s"). It never throws.

members.name: prompt
doc: The instructions sent with the image (default: the page-text prompt).

members.name: json
doc: Ask for a JSON reply (a structured reading such as a roster). I treat a cut-off reply then as an error, not as a reading with a marker.

members.name: maxAttempts
doc: Attempts per read, the first included (default 3: the first and two retries).

members.name: noWait
doc: Test hook: no real waiting between retries.

members.name: maxRetryWaitMs
doc: The longest wait I accept when the service asks for one on a per-minute limit (default 30 s); a longer one fails at once.

members.name: sleepImpl
doc: Used by tests: it replaces the real wait and is told how long it was asked to wait.

symbols.name: sniffImageMime
doc: Tells the kind of an image from its first bytes (the archive's page images may be PNG, JPEG or WebP). When unsure I answer PNG.

symbols.name: STOPPED_MARKER
symbols.sig: const STOPPED_MARKER = "[reading incomplete: the reply was cut off or the model began repeating itself]"
doc: I write this at the end of a reading that did not reach the end of the page: cut off by the service, or the model began repeating the same line.

symbols.name: LOOP_RUN
doc: This many identical lines in a row (blank table rows count as identical) mean to me that the model is looping.

symbols.name: BLANK_ROW
doc: A table row with no text in any cell.

symbols.name: cutAtLoop
doc: Cuts a reading where the model began repeating itself: from the first line of a run of LOOP_RUN identical lines (blank table rows count as identical) I drop the rest and write STOPPED_MARKER. A text without such a run is returned unchanged.

symbols.name: readerFromEnv
symbols.sig: export function readerFromEnv(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): PageReader | null
doc: Gives the reader the settings ask for, or null for none.

behaviours: the reader names its model
the text of all parts is joined and trimmed
the request goes to the model's generateContent address
the key travels in a header, not in the address
the request carries the instructions and the page as inline image data
the temperature is zero
the instructions forbid guessing digits and ask for table rows as 'Column: value'
no key: a clear error
a busy service (429) is retried and then succeeds
a service that stays down fails after the retries
a wrong model name is NOT retried and is reported, with what to do about it
an empty answer is an error that says why
a network failure is an error
the default model is the one Google named (gemini-3.8-flash)
a PNG is image/png
a JPEG is image/jpeg
a WebP is image/webp
anything unknown is sent as image/png
the request carries the real kind of the image
a normal reply (STOP) is returned as it is
a reply without a finish reason is returned as it is
a reply cut off at the length limit is marked incomplete
a reply stopped by a safety rule is marked incomplete too
a model that began repeating blank table rows is cut: what came before stays, one blank row stays, the marker is written
the marker is written once even when the reply was also cut off
six blank table rows in a row are a loop
five blank rows are not a loop
six identical text lines are a loop too
a text without a loop is unchanged
the prompt tells the model not to write blank form rows out
no setting: no reader
gemini by setting
the local-model setting no longer exists: no reader
the setting is not case-sensitive
maxAttempts 2: a service that stays down is asked twice, then fails
maxAttempts 1: asked once
a hung attempt is abandoned at the timeout and the retry succeeds
the failed attempt is reported with its number, how long it ran and why
every failed attempt before a success is reported (two here)
a read that succeeds first time reports nothing
parseQuotaError: a daily limit says so, with its size, the model and that it renews daily
parseQuotaError: a per-minute limit says the wait the service asked for
parseQuotaError: a tokens-per-minute limit is a per-minute limit
parseQuotaError: only a message with a wait still gives the wait
parseQuotaError: nothing readable gives a plain 'quota exceeded' and never throws
parseQuotaError: the summary has no brackets (it is put inside brackets)
a DAILY limit fails at once: one call, no waiting
...and the message keeps the whole body (the quota id is in it)
a PER-MINUTE limit is waited out for exactly what the service asked (17 s and half a second), then the read succeeds
a wait longer than 30 s is not waited for here: one call, then it fails
maxRetryWaitMs allows a longer wait when asked
a 429 with no detail keeps the fixed back-off (1.5 s, then 4 s) and three calls
the failed attempt reported to the log starts with the plain summary (it survives any later cutting)
a 503 is still retried three times as before
